body:
Hi & thanks for the response!

I'm building from sources using the bash script built by Morgan Hardwood (I think initially for RawTherapee) which fetches the latest sources and builds. This is on Fedora 44. 

I've tried two versions: self-built and the AppImage. 

- Self-built shows white thumbnails in browser and and a white image in the editor
- AppImage shows white in browser, but the actual image in the editor 

On the self-built one the ART about screen shows LibRaw, OpenColorIO and CTL Interpreter to be absent in the build. The latest LibRaw and OpenColorIO are installed on my system:
